strongest_reason: The opportunity fails on multiple deterministic gates: pain intensity (2/10), frequency (2/10), and willingness to pay (2/10) are all critically low, indicating the problem is not acute or frequent enough to drive adoption or revenue.
strongest_risk: Existential platform risk from Meta: if WhatsApp ever adds historical message access to their official Business API, the product becomes worthless overnight, and Meta has the resources and incentive to do so.
unresolved_assumption: Whether developers would actually pay for a solution when free workarounds (open-source scripts, manual exports, backup extraction tools) exist and the pain is intermittent.
recommended_next_step: If pursuing further, conduct primary market research with 20+ WhatsApp automation developers to validate willingness to pay and quantify the actual cost (time/money) of current workarounds, and assess legal feasibility of accessing historical data without violating WhatsApp's terms.
